body_text: Zhongらは約90回のLSAT試験から、分析的推論の設問を収集した。5選択肢を持つ問題を残し、AR-LSATとして2021年に公開した。
原研究は、学習済み言語モデルによる回答と、文章から事実・論理関数を抽出して配置を探索するAnalytical Reasoning Machine（ARM）を比較した。

body_text: 公開データには条件文、設問、5選択肢、A〜Eの正解、ID、設問のtagsが含まれる。正解は問題に付属する選択肢ラベルとして与えられる。
ARMは参加者・位置・論理関数を抽出する。原研究は開発データで参加者・位置を人手注釈して抽出性能を測ったが、全問題に完成した論理式を付けたデータセットではない。

manifest.json.title: まとめ：五択の背後に、配置の集合がある
manifest.json.section: 4. 研究での位置付けと入手
body_text: AR-LSATは、試験由来の英語の条件文を使い、順序・グループ・割当についての分析的推論を問う。条件文と追加条件を保ち、全5候補の中から一つを選ぶ。
公開テストは230問。HELMの標準条件は5例提示のjoint方式で、ここで比較した固定版モデルの正答率は22〜23%台。原論文、現在の配布、公開実行の条件を分けて読む。

manifest.json.title: Appendix
実例4：募集した順番を絞り込む
manifest.json.quoted_text:
A detective is trying to determine the order in which a criminal recruited seven accomplices—Peters, Quinn, Rovero, Stanton, Tao, Villas, and White. In addition to discovering that the suspect recruited the accomplices one at a time, the detective has established the following: Stanton was recruited neither immediately before nor immediately after Tao. Quinn was recruited earlier than Rovero. Villas was recruited immediately before White. Peters was recruited fourth.
If White was recruited immediately before Quinn, which one of the following must have been recruited sixth?
A. Quinn   /   B. Rovero   /   C. Stanton   /   D. Villas   /   E. White

manifest.json.title: 実例4：日本語訳
manifest.json.quoted_text:
刑事が、ある犯人がPeters、Quinn、Rovero、Stanton、Tao、Villas、Whiteの7人を仲間に誘った順番を調べている。1人ずつ誘ったことに加え、次のことが分かっている。StantonはTaoの直前でも直後でもない。QuinnはRoveroより先。VillasはWhiteの直前。Petersは4番目。
WhiteがQuinnの直前だった場合、必ず6番目に誘われたのは誰か。
A. Quinn   /   B. Rovero   /   C. Stanton   /   D. Villas   /   E. White

manifest.json.title: 実例5：メンバーとリーダーを選ぶ
manifest.json.quoted_text:
Seven workers—Quinn, Ruiz, Smith, Taylor, Verma, Wells, and Xue—are being considered for a special project. Exactly three of the workers will be selected to be project members, and exactly one of these project members will be the project leader. The selection is subject to the following constraints: Quinn or Ruiz can be a project member only if leading the project. If Smith is a project member, Taylor must also be. If Wells is a project member, neither Ruiz nor Verma can be.
If Taylor is not a project member, which one of the following workers must be a project member?
A. Quinn   /   B. Ruiz   /   C. Verma   /   D. Wells   /   E. Xue

manifest.json.title: 実例5：日本語訳
manifest.json.quoted_text:
Quinn、Ruiz、Smith、Taylor、Verma、Wells、Xueの7人から、特別プロジェクトのメンバーをちょうど3人選ぶ。そのうち、ちょうど1人をリーダーにする。QuinnまたはRuizがメンバーになるには、その人がリーダーでなければならない。Smithを選ぶならTaylorも選ぶ。Wellsを選ぶならRuizもVermaも選ばない。
Taylorを選ばない場合、必ずメンバーになるのは誰か。
A. Quinn   /   B. Ruiz   /   C. Verma   /   D. Wells   /   E. Xue

manifest.json.title: 実例6：異なる分野の記事を並べる
manifest.json.quoted_text:
An editor will edit seven articles, one at a time. Three of the articles—G, H, and J—cover finance; three other articles—Q, R, and S—cover nutrition; and the remaining article, Y, covers wildlife. The order in which the articles are edited is subject to the following conditions: Consecutive articles cannot cover the same topic as each other. S can be earlier than Q only if Q is third. S must be earlier than Y. J must be earlier than G, and G must be earlier than R.
Which one of the following could be true?
A. G is second   /   B. H is second.   /   C. S is second   /   D. R is third.   /   E. Y is third

manifest.json.title: 実例6：日本語訳
manifest.json.quoted_text:
編集者が7本の記事を1本ずつ編集する。G、H、Jは金融、Q、R、Sは栄養、Yは野生生物を扱う。同じ分野の記事を続けて編集してはならない。SがQより先になるには、Qが3番目でなければならない。SはYより先。JはGより先で、GはRより先。
次のうち、成立する可能性があるのはどれか。
A. Gが2番目   /   B. Hが2番目   /   C. Sが2番目   /   D. Rが3番目   /   E. Yが3番目

manifest.json.title: 実例7：荷物と積み込み区画
manifest.json.quoted_text:
A loading dock consists of exactly six bays numbered 1 through 6 consecutively from one side of the dock to the other. Each bay is holding a different one of exactly six types of cargo—fuel, grain, livestock, machinery, produce, or textiles. The following apply: The bay holding grain has a higher number than the bay holding livestock. The bay holding livestock has a higher number than the bay holding textiles. The bay holding produce has a higher number than the bay holding fuel. The bay holding textiles is next to the bay holding produce.
Which one of the following CANNOT be the type of cargo held in bay 4?
A. grain   /   B. livestock   /   C. machinery   /   D. produce   /   E. textiles

manifest.json.title: 実例7：日本語訳
manifest.json.quoted_text:
荷積み場には、一方から順に1〜6と番号を付けた6区画がある。各区画には、燃料、穀物、家畜、機械、農産物、繊維製品のうち、異なる1種類を置く。穀物の番号は家畜より大きく、家畜の番号は繊維製品より大きい。農産物の番号は燃料より大きい。繊維製品の区画は農産物の区画と隣接する。
区画4に置くことができない荷物はどれか。
A. 穀物   /   B. 家畜   /   C. 機械   /   D. 農産物   /   E. 繊維製品

manifest.json.title: 実例8：8曲の演奏順を決める
manifest.json.quoted_text:
At a concert, exactly eight compositions—F, H, L, O, P, R, S, and T—are to be performed exactly once each, consecutively and one composition at a time. The order of their performance must satisfy the following conditions: T is performed either immediately before F or immediately after R. At least two compositions are performed either after F and before R, or after R and before F. O is performed either first or fifth. The eighth composition performed is either L or H. P is performed at some time before S. At least one composition is performed either after O and before S, or after S and before O.
P CANNOT be performed
A. second   /   B. third   /   C. fourth   /   D. sixth   /   E. seventh

manifest.json.title: 実例8：日本語訳
manifest.json.quoted_text:
F、H、L、O、P、R、S、Tの8曲を、1曲ずつ続けて、それぞれ1回演奏する。TはFの直前、またはRの直後。FとRの間には少なくとも2曲入る。Oは1番目または5番目。8番目はLまたはH。PはSより先。OとSの間には少なくとも1曲入る。
Pを演奏できない順番はどれか。
A. 2番目   /   B. 3番目   /   C. 4番目   /   D. 6番目   /   E. 7番目

manifest.json.title: 実例9：専門分野をまたぐ委員選び
manifest.json.quoted_text:
A panel of five scientists will be formed. The panelists will be selected from among three botanists—F, G, and H—three chemists—K, L, and M—and three zoologists—P, Q, and R. Selection is governed by the following conditions: The panel must include at least one scientist of each of the three types. If more than one botanist is selected, then at most one zoologist is selected. F and K cannot both be selected. K and M cannot both be selected. If M is selected, both P and R must be selected.
If four of the scientists selected are F, L, Q, and R, which one of the following must be the fifth scientist selected?
A. G   /   B. H   /   C. K   /   D. M   /   E. P

manifest.json.title: 実例9：日本語訳
manifest.json.quoted_text:
植物学者F、G、H、化学者K、L、M、動物学者P、Q、Rから、5人の委員を選ぶ。各分野から少なくとも1人を含める。植物学者を2人以上選ぶなら、動物学者は多くても1人。FとKは同時に選べず、KとMも同時に選べない。Mを選ぶなら、PとRも選ぶ。
選ばれた4人がF、L、Q、Rである場合、5人目として必ず選ばれるのは誰か。
A. G   /   B. H   /   C. K   /   D. M   /   E. P

manifest.json.title: 実例10：二つのチームと進行役
manifest.json.quoted_text:
A teacher will assign each of five students—Juana, Kelly, Lateefah, Mei, and Olga—to exactly one of two research teams, the green team and the red team. One team will have two members, and the other will have three members. One member of each team will be designated as facilitator. The assignment must satisfy the following conditions: Juana is assigned to a different team than Olga is. Lateefah is assigned to the green team. Kelly is not a facilitator. Olga is a facilitator.
Which one of the following must be true?
A. Juana is assigned to the red team.   /   B. Lateefah is a facilitator.   /   C. Olga is assigned to the green team.   /   D. Juana and Mei are not both facilitators.   /   E. Neither Juana nor Kelly is a facilitator.
manifest.json.answer_text: D. Juana and Mei are not both facilitators.

manifest.json.title: 実例10：日本語訳
manifest.json.quoted_text:
教師がJuana、Kelly、Lateefah、Mei、Olgaの5人を、緑または赤のどちらか一方の研究チームに割り当てる。一方は2人、他方は3人。各チームで1人を進行役にする。JuanaとOlgaは別のチーム。Lateefahは緑チーム。Kellyは進行役ではない。Olgaは進行役。
次のうち、必ず成り立つのはどれか。
A. Juanaは赤チーム   /   B. Lateefahは進行役   /   C. Olgaは緑チーム   /   D. JuanaとMeiがともに進行役になることはない   /   E. JuanaもKellyも進行役ではない
manifest.json.answer_text: D. JuanaとMeiがともに進行役になることはない

manifest.json.title: 実例11：営業担当者と三つの区域
manifest.json.quoted_text:
A software company employs exactly seven sales representatives—Kim, Mahr, Parra, Quinn, Stuckey, Tiao, and Udall—to work in its three sales zones—Zone 1, Zone 2, and Zone 3. Each sales representative works in exactly one of the sales zones, in accordance with the following conditions: Either Parra or Tiao (but not both) works in Zone 1. Either Tiao or Udall (but not both) works in Zone 2. Parra and Quinn work in the same sales zone as each other. Stuckey and Udall work in the same sales zone as each other. There are more of the sales representatives working in Zone 3 than in Zone 2.
Quinn CANNOT work in the same sales zone as which one of the following?
A. Kim   /   B. Mahr   /   C. Stuckey   /   D. Tiao   /   E. Udall

manifest.json.title: 実例11：日本語訳
manifest.json.quoted_text:
ソフトウェア会社の営業担当者Kim、Mahr、Parra、Quinn、Stuckey、Tiao、Udallの7人を、区域1、2、3のどれか一つに割り当てる。ParraとTiaoのうち、区域1にいるのは一方だけ。TiaoとUdallのうち、区域2にいるのは一方だけ。ParraとQuinnは同じ区域。StuckeyとUdallは同じ区域。区域3の人数は区域2より多い。
Quinnと同じ区域に割り当てることができないのは誰か。
A. Kim   /   B. Mahr   /   C. Stuckey   /   D. Tiao   /   E. Udall

manifest.json.title: 実例12：本を三段の棚へ配置する
manifest.json.quoted_text:
Exactly eight books—F, G, H, I, K, L, M, O—are placed on a bookcase with exactly three shelves—the top shelf, the middle shelf, and the bottom shelf. At least two books are placed on each shelf. The following conditions must apply: More of the books are placed on the bottom shelf than the top shelf. I is placed on the middle shelf. K is placed on a higher shelf than F. O is placed on a higher shelf than L. F is placed on the same shelf as M.
Which one of the following could be a complete and accurate list of the books placed on the bottom shelf?
A. F, M   /   B. F, H, M   /   C. G, H, K   /   D. F, G, M, O   /   E. G, H, L, M

manifest.json.title: 実例12：日本語訳
manifest.json.quoted_text:
F、G、H、I、K、L、M、Oの8冊を、上段、中段、下段の3段の本棚に置く。各段に少なくとも2冊置く。下段は上段より冊数が多い。Iは中段。KはFより上の段。OはLより上の段。FとMは同じ段。
下段に置く本の、正確かつ全冊を含む一覧として可能なのはどれか。
A. F・M   /   B. F・H・M   /   C. G・H・K   /   D. F・G・M・O   /   E. G・H・L・M

manifest.json.title: 実例13：読書会の作品を選ぶ
manifest.json.quoted_text:
The organizer of a reading club will select at least five and at most six works from a group of nine works. The group consists of three French novels, three Russian novels, two French plays, and one Russian play. The organizer's selection of works must conform to the following requirements: No more than four French works are selected. At least three but no more than four novels are selected. At least as many French novels as Russian novels are selected. If both French plays are selected, then the Russian play is not selected.
The organizer must at least select
A. one French novel and one French play   /   B. one French novel and one Russian play   /   C. one Russian novel and one French play   /   D. two French novels   /   E. two Russian novels

manifest.json.title: 実例13：日本語訳
manifest.json.quoted_text:
読書会の主催者が、9作品から5〜6作品を選ぶ。候補はフランス小説3作、ロシア小説3作、フランス戯曲2作、ロシア戯曲1作。選ぶフランス作品は4作以下。小説は3〜4作。フランス小説の数はロシア小説以上。フランス戯曲を2作とも選ぶなら、ロシア戯曲は選ばない。
最低限、次のどれを選ばなければならないか。
A. フランス小説1作とフランス戯曲1作   /   B. フランス小説1作とロシア戯曲1作   /   C. ロシア小説1作とフランス戯曲1作   /   D. フランス小説2作   /   E. ロシア小説2作
